params.name: name
params.description: Specifies the name of the place (POI) to be searched. Also performs search on partially specified names. It requires minimum 3 characters to search.

params.name: type
params.description: Filters the points of interest (POIs) by place types.

params.name: categoryCode
params.description: Acts as a filter to narrow down and refine POI search results. The category codes are unique 4, 6, or 11 digit numeric values.

params.name: sicCode
params.description: Acts as a filter to narrow down and refine POI search results. The SIC codes are unique 4 or 8 digit numerical values

params.name: maxCandidates
params.description: Maximum number of POIs that can be retrieved

params.name: searchRadius
params.description: Radius range within which search is performed.

params.name: searchRadiusUnit
params.description: Radius unit such as Feet, Kilometers, Miles or Meters (default).

params.name: travelTime
params.description: Travel time within which search is performed (POIs which can be reached within travel time).

params.name: travelTimeUnit
params.description: Travel time unit such as minutes (default), hours, seconds or milliseconds.

params.name: travelDistance
params.description: Travel distance within which search is performed (POIs which can be reached within travel distance).

params.name: travelDistanceUnit
params.description: Travel distance unit such as Feet (default), Kilometers, Miles or Meters.

params.name: travelMode
params.description: Mode of commute.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Whether to sort the results based on relevance (best match) or by nearest distance from input location.

params.name: fuzzyOnName
params.description: Whether to allow fuzzy seacrh on name input.

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies the page number of results where page size is the value of maxCandidates input in request.

params.name: matchMode
params.description: Determine the leniency used to make a match between the input name and the reference data.

params.name: specificMatchOn
params.description: Specifies the field for the Specific Match Mode.

params.description: Three digit ISO country code

params.name: resolution
params.description: This is resolution of the buffer. Curves generated in buffer are approximated by line segments and it is measured in segments per circle. The higher the resolution, the smoother the curves of the buffer but more points would be required in the boundary geometry. Number greater than 0 and in multiple of 4. If not in 4, then it is approximated to nearest multiple of 4.
